landing.tagline: Understand local dish risk and speak up at the table.
landing.positioning: An allergy-aware travel food assistant for Hanoi. Build a private allergy profile, browse local dishes by risk level, and generate bilingual question cards for restaurant staff.
landing.noInstall: No install required — it runs right in your browser.

safety.disclaimer: This app helps you understand possible allergy risks. It cannot guarantee food safety. Always confirm ingredients and preparation with restaurant staff before ordering.
safety.offlineNotice: You are offline. Showing saved information only. Please confirm with restaurant staff before ordering.
safety.suitableCaveat: This looks lower risk for your profile, but please confirm with staff before ordering.
